docs.text: MCP is Model Context Protocol, an open standard for connecting AI assistants to data sources. It defines tools, resources, and prompts.
Use list_files tool to list files under ALLOWED_ROOT. It supports recursive listing.
RAG is Retrieval Augmented Generation. Ingest text via rag_ingest, search via rag_search, read via docs:// resource.
Vector embedding converts text to 128-dim normalized vectors for cosine similarity search.
Auth modes: none, apiKey (X-API-Key), bearer (Authorization Bearer). Health/ready bypass auth.
BM25 is a ranking function for keyword search using term frequency and inverse document frequency.
Rate limiting uses express-rate-limit, default 100 per 15min on /mcp, returns 429 Too Many Requests.
OTEL is OpenTelemetry for tracing and metrics, enabled via OTEL_ENABLED and OTLP endpoint.
Admin UI at /admin shows tools, resources, prompts, metrics, spans, stores. Protected by ADMIN_TOKEN via X-Admin-Token.
RedisEventStore enables horizontal scale, storing events for Last-Event-ID replay, fallback to memory if no REDIS_URL.
Slack plugin provides slack_list_channels, slack_post_message, slack_search. Mock if SLACK_TOKEN not set.
Notion plugin provides notion_search, notion_get_page, notion_create_page. Mock if NOTION_TOKEN not set.
Create background task via create_task with duration, poll via get_task and get_task_result. Experimental delay_task if tasks enabled.
RBAC roles: reader < writer < admin. Use X-Role header. Write_file requires writer, shell_execute requires admin.
Hybrid search combines vector cosine and BM25 scores with alpha 0.5, re-ranked for better relevance.
Run k6 via npm run bench or bench:local, thresholds p95<100ms, checks >99%.
Docker compose includes app, redis, postgres, qdrant, otel-collector with healthchecks.
SLO checks memory, rag, cache, uptime via checkSlo(), used in /health and /ready.
Backup saves memory and rag to ALLOWED_ROOT/.backup.json via scheduleSave(), loadBackup() at startup.
Prometheus metrics via prom-client at /metrics: mcp_http_requests_total, mcp_http_request_duration_ms, mcp_sessions_active.
